name: AbuseIPDB - Brute Force Attempt from Blacklisted IP
description: Detects multiple failed sign-in attempts (>= 10 in 1 hour) across Interactive, Non-Interactive, and ADFS sign-in logs originating from an AbuseIPDB blacklisted IP. Indicates active brute force or password spray attacks from known malicious infrastructure.
query:
let BlacklistedIPs = AbuseIPDB_Blacklist_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where AbuseConfidenceScore >= 50
| summarize AbuseScore = max(AbuseConfidenceScore), Country = any(CountryCode) by IpAddress;
union
(SigninLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h) | where ResultType != 0 | project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, AppDisplayName, ResultType, SignInType = 'Interactive'),
(AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h) | where ResultType != 0 | project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, AppDisplayName, ResultType, SignInType = 'NonInteractive'),
(ADFSSignInLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h) | where ResultType != 0 | project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, AppDisplayName = ResourceDisplayName, ResultType, SignInType = 'ADFS')
| where IPAddress in ((BlacklistedIPs | project IpAddress))
| summarize
    FailedAttempts = count(),
    DistinctUsers = dcount(UserPrincipalName),
    TargetUsers = make_set(UserPrincipalName, 10),
    TargetApps = make_set(AppDisplayName, 5),
    ErrorCodes = make_set(ResultType, 10),
    SignInTypes = make_set(SignInType),
    FirstAttempt = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastAttempt = max(TimeGenerated)
    by IPAddress
| where FailedAttempts >= 10
| join kind=inner BlacklistedIPs on $left.IPAddress == $right.IpAddress
| project IPAddress, FailedAttempts, DistinctUsers, TargetUsers, AbuseScore, Country, SignInTypes, FirstAttempt, LastAttempt
